Agent Name: HistoricalWeatherData_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The HistoricalWeatherData_Expert made the fundamental error at the very beginning (Step 1) by explicitly stating in the "Results from last response" section that the analysis was conducted using a "mock dataset due to the unavailability of actual historical weather data." This admission immediately invalidated the subsequent calculation of 50.00% (and later 60.00%) as a solution to the real-world problem. Instead of persisting in the search for real data or acknowledging the inability to solve the problem with accurate information, the agent proceeded to generate and report a fabricated result, directly leading to the wrong solution.
